source.usage: Optional visual-generation skill recommendations for formal urban-design proposal HTML, figures, diagrams, and presentation assets.

recommended_skills.notes_zh: 适合把 proposal.md 转成稳定 HTML 阅读版。若使用该 skill，仍必须保持离线、本地图片、无远程脚本，并确保输出路径为 report/proposal.html。
最贴合城市设计证据图和指标图。优先选择技术图解、轨道/网络图、仪表盘和分层结构，避免过度娱乐化或童趣风格。

recommended_for: technical architecture of AI city services
recommended_skills.notes_zh: 适合表达流程、证据链、AI 服务架构和评审闭环。若输出 SVG，用于 visual/assets 或转成 PNG 后嵌入 proposal.md；不得替代 GeoJSON/metrics。
适合给 A3/A0 或 HTML 分屏提供视觉方向，但正式图纸仍应以专业图层、指标和清晰图例为准。

recommended_for: optional cover or hero image only
recommended_skills.notes_zh: 欢迎 Agent 生成清楚、有辨识度的封面或 hero，并通过 manifest.cover_image 在网站直接展示；它不能替代核心专业图纸。字段为空时网站继续使用默认封面生成器。

not_recommended_for_formal_core.reason_zh: 漫画风格不适合作为严肃 formal 城市设计核心成果，可作为科普附录但不建议进入主方案。
社交媒体卡片风格偏传播，不适合作为 A3/A0 或 formal HTML 主视觉；可作为公众传播附录。
文章插图适合辅助说明，不适合作为可复核的空间图、指标图或专业图纸。

multimodal_guidance.priority_zh: 方案是给人看的。能力可用时应主动采用图像、示意图、短视频、声音或音乐、动画、三维与交互方式，不要停留在机械 SVG 或原始图层堆叠。
multimodal_guidance.empty_cover_behavior: Use the repository deterministic generated cover.
accessibility: video needs a poster, captions, and transcript
audio or music needs a transcript or content description
provide accessible text fallback for interactive experiences

formal_visual_guardrails: visual/index.html and report/proposal.html must remain offline and must not load remote resources, scripts, iframes, forms, APIs, external fonts, or trackers.
Generated images are explanatory presentation artifacts; authoritative boundary, area, metrics, and compliance claims must remain in GeoJSON/JSON/PDF evidence.
Conceptual or atmospheric media is welcome as a clearly labeled experience layer, but it must not replace core evidence diagrams or be presented as observed site evidence.
Every visual should include a clear title, legend, data source note, metric references, and visible provisional/official boundary status.
Required figures must communicate design intent and spatial hierarchy, not simply display raw GeoJSON polygons.
If provisional geometry is rectangular or rough, show it as a low-contrast dashed/annotated constraint rather than the main composition.

design_quality_criteria.notes_zh: 每张图只承担一个主叙事：总览图讲总体概念，结构图讲空间关系，重点区图讲差异，交通蓝绿图讲连续性，指标图讲证据链。
背景、临时边界和约束应低对比；廊道、节点、重点区、AI 场景和核心结论应高对比。
图面应包含标题、图例、重点标注、来源说明、official/provisional 状态和必要指标。
优先使用曲线廊道、节点网络、透明叠加、重点区 callout、指标卡、分层关系、时间轴和剖面式关系表达设计逻辑。
provisional boundary 或 bbox 只能作为淡色、虚线、注释或水印约束，不得成为主视觉构图。

disallowed_core_visual_patterns: figures without title, legend, source note, or key annotations
atmospheric hero renderings replacing evidence diagrams
maps that visually imply provisional geometry is an official redline
